【原视频简介】
OpenAI says its AI has solved the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem. It released a mathematical proof and computer-checkable files on September 8, 2026.

The claim concerns whether equations used to describe water and air can develop a mathematical breakdown. The result uses a smooth outside force—allowed under the official problem—but does not settle the same question without that force.

Alongside the announcement came a dispute over research credit and private data. Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster described pressure over authorship. Sébastien Bubeck rejected the allegations. OpenAI denied accessing the researchers’ unpublished work, while leaving a possible training-data connection unresolved.
What the proof claims, how the research unfolded, and what remains disputed—in plain language.

Account as of September 8, 2026. Publication does not mean the prize has been awarded.

#OpenAI #NavierStokes #Mathematics
